descripcion: Furniture and objects of a home: living room, kitchen, bedroom, bathroom, hallway and the clutter usually left in the way.

subcategorias.jardin_terraza: Garden, paddling pool and outdoor storage

sofa.descripcion: Fabric sofa, soft and low. It gives when touched; walk around its sides.
sofa.imagen: Footprint of “Sofa”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “So”.

sofa_ele.descripcion: Sofa with a long arm sticking out to the front on one side, like an L. It fills the corner and leaves a gap in front.
sofa_ele.imagen: Footprint of “Corner sofa”: an L shape, 2.60 by 1.70 metres, marked with the letters “Se”.

sillon.imagen: Footprint of “Armchair”: a rectangle, 0.85 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Si”.

mesa_centro.descripcion: Low table in front of the sofa, at knee height: the cane finds it, the hand does not.
mesa_centro.imagen: Footprint of “Coffee table”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

mesa_redonda.descripcion: Round dining table on a single central leg. No corners to walk around.
mesa_redonda.imagen: Footprint of “Round table”: a circle, 1.10 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

mesa_comedor.descripcion: Large, tall dining table with chairs around it.
mesa_comedor.imagen: Footprint of “Dining table”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

mueble_tv.descripcion: Long, low unit with the television on top. When on, you hear voices and music: a good landmark.
mueble_tv.imagen: Footprint of “TV unit with television”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.42 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

estanteria.descripcion: Tall, shallow bookcase against the wall, full of books.
estanteria.imagen: Footprint of “Bookcase”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

lampara_pie.descripcion: Floor lamp: a heavy round base with a thin pole. It wobbles if you push it.
lampara_pie.imagen: Footprint of “Floor lamp”: a circle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Lp”.

alfombra.descripcion: Rug: it does not block your way, but your steps sound muffled on it. A landmark under your feet.
alfombra.imagen: Footprint of “Rug”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “Al”.

piano.descripcion: Upright piano: a tall wooden case with the keyboard at the front. Touch it and three notes sound.
piano.imagen: Footprint of “Upright piano”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Pi”.

piano_cola.descripcion: Grand piano: straight keyboard at the front and a long curved case behind. It takes up a lot of room.
piano_cola.imagen: Footprint of “Grand piano”: the outline of a grand piano, keyboard at the front, 1.50 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

planta_grande.descripcion: Large pot on the floor with a tall plant. You brush the leaves before reaching the pot.
planta_grande.imagen: Footprint of “Large plant”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pg”.

encimera.descripcion: Straight run of kitchen base units with a worktop, at hip height.
encimera.imagen: Footprint of “Worktop”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.62 metres, marked with the letters “En”.

encimera_ele.descripcion: Kitchen base units turning the corner in an L.
encimera_ele.imagen: Footprint of “L-shaped worktop”: an L shape, 2.40 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ee”.

isla.descripcion: Free-standing block of worktop in the middle of the kitchen: you can walk all the way round it.
isla.imagen: Footprint of “Kitchen island”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.80 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Is”.

frigorifico.descripcion: Tall metal fridge. It hums quietly all the time: a good landmark in the kitchen.
frigorifico.imagen: Footprint of “Fridge”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.66 metres, marked with the letters “Fr”.

cocina.descripcion: Cooker with a hob on top and an oven below. Hot when on: do not rest your hand on it.
cocina.imagen: Footprint of “Cooker”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

horno.descripcion: Tall unit with the oven at mid height. The door drops down and takes up room in front.
horno.imagen: Footprint of “Oven tower”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.58 metres, marked with the letters “Ho”.

lavavajillas.descripcion: Dishwasher under the worktop. When running you hear water sweeping inside.
lavavajillas.imagen: Footprint of “Dishwasher”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “La”.

fregadero.descripcion: Steel sink with its tap. With the tap on you hear running water.
fregadero.imagen: Footprint of “Sink with tap”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Fr”.

mesa_cocina.descripcion: Kitchen table with the chairs tucked under it.
mesa_cocina.imagen: Footprint of “Kitchen table”: a rectangle, 1.10 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

silla.descripcion: Chair with a backrest. It is light: push it and it scrapes along.
silla.imagen: Footprint of “Chair”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.48 metres, marked with the letters “Si”.

taburete.descripcion: Round stool without a back. Low and easy to knock over.
taburete.imagen: Footprint of “Stool”: a circle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Ta”.

cubo_basura.descripcion: Rubbish bin with a lid, hollow plastic.
cubo_basura.imagen: Footprint of “Kitchen bin”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

microondas.descripcion: Microwave standing on the worktop, at chest height. The cane misses it: your hand finds it.
microondas.imagen: Footprint of “Microwave”: a rectangle, 0.48 by 0.38 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Mi”.

armarios_altos.descripcion: Cupboards hung above the worktop, at head height. The cane passes underneath: mind your head when leaning in.
armarios_altos.imagen: Footprint of “Kitchen wall cupboards”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.35 metres, hanging 1.45 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Aa”.

cama.descripcion: Bed with a mattress: low, soft and long. Headboard against the wall; walk round the foot.
cama.imagen: Footprint of “Bed”: a rectangle, 1.35 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

cama_cabecero.descripcion: Bed with a wooden headboard wider than the mattress: it sticks out a hand's width on each side.
cama_cabecero.imagen: Footprint of “Bed with headboard”: a rectangle with a wider headboard at the back, 1.60 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

litera.descripcion: Bunk bed, one bed above the other, with a ladder. The top bunk is at head height.
litera.imagen: Footprint of “Bunk bed”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Li”.

cuna.descripcion: Cot with wooden bars, waist high.
cuna.imagen: Footprint of “Cot”: a rectangle, 0.66 by 1.26 metres, marked with the letters “Cu”.

mesilla.descripcion: Low table with a drawer, beside the head of the bed.
mesilla.imagen: Footprint of “Bedside table”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

armario.descripcion: Tall wardrobe, almost up to the ceiling. The doors open outwards and take up room in front.
armario.imagen: Footprint of “Wardrobe”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

comoda.descripcion: Chest of drawers at waist height.
comoda.imagen: Footprint of “Chest of drawers”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

escritorio.descripcion: Study desk with drawers, against the wall.
escritorio.imagen: Footprint of “Desk”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

silla_escritorio.descripcion: Swivel chair on five castors. Bump into it and it rolls away.
silla_escritorio.imagen: Footprint of “Wheeled desk chair”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Se”.

perchero.descripcion: Wooden pole with arms at the top for hanging clothes. Thin at the bottom; bulky at the top with coats on.
perchero.imagen: Footprint of “Coat stand”: a circle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Pe”.

baul.descripcion: Wooden trunk at the foot of the bed, with a lifting lid. Something may be kept inside.
baul.imagen: Footprint of “Trunk”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

inodoro.descripcion: Ceramic toilet with the cistern behind it, against the wall. Hard and cold to the touch.
inodoro.imagen: Footprint of “Toilet”: a rectangle at the back (the cistern) and a rounded bowl at the front, 0.38 by 0.68 metres, marked with the letters “In”.

lavabo.descripcion: Washbasin with its tap, at waist height. With the tap on you hear the water.
lavabo.imagen: Footprint of “Washbasin”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.46 metres, marked with the letters “La”.

bide.descripcion: Low ceramic bidet next to the toilet.
bide.imagen: Footprint of “Bidet”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.37 by 0.56 metres, marked with the letters “Bi”.

banera.descripcion: Long bathtub with its rim at knee height: you have to lift your leg to get in.
banera.imagen: Footprint of “Bathtub”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.70 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

ducha.descripcion: Shower closed in by a glass screen. Open the screen to get in; closed, it blocks the way.
ducha.imagen: Footprint of “Shower enclosure”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Du”.

plato_ducha.descripcion: Walk-in shower tray in the corner, no screen. You step on it: the floor changes and may be slippery.
plato_ducha.aviso: Shower tray: the floor is wet.
plato_ducha.imagen: Footprint of “Corner shower tray”: a quarter circle with its corner at the back left, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Pd”.

lavadora.descripcion: Front-loading washing machine. When running it hums and spins: you can hear it from the hallway.
lavadora.imagen: Footprint of “Washing machine”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.58 metres, marked with the letters “La”.

toallero.descripcion: Towel rail fixed to the wall at waist height. The cane, sweeping the floor, misses it.
toallero.imagen: Footprint of “Wall towel rail”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.10 metres, hanging 0.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “To”.

zapatero.descripcion: Tall, shallow shoe cabinet against the wall.
zapatero.imagen: Footprint of “Shoe cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Za”.

paraguero.descripcion: Narrow metal tub by the door with umbrellas in it.
paraguero.imagen: Footprint of “Umbrella stand”: a circle, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Pa”.

consola.descripcion: Narrow hall table, straight against the wall and round at the front: no corners.
consola.imagen: Footprint of “Half-moon console table”: a semicircle, straight at the back and round at the front, 1.00 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

banco.descripcion: Low bench to sit on while putting shoes on; the seat lifts and things are kept inside.
banco.imagen: Footprint of “Hall bench”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.38 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

espejo.descripcion: Framed mirror hung on the wall, from waist to head. It sticks out only a little, but the cane gives no warning.
espejo.imagen: Footprint of “Wall mirror”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.05 metres, hanging 0.90 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Es”.

radiador.descripcion: Low metal radiator against the wall. Warm in winter.
radiador.imagen: Footprint of “Radiator”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.10 metres, hanging 0.12 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ra”.

extintor.descripcion: Metal fire extinguisher hung on the wall one metre up. It sticks out and the cane passes under it.
extintor.imagen: Footprint of “Wall fire extinguisher”: a circle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.00 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ex”.

felpudo.descripcion: Rough mat in front of the door. You feel it underfoot: you are at the entrance.
felpudo.imagen: Footprint of “Doormat”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Fe”.

tendedero.descripcion: Open metal clothes airer with washing on it. Light, with its wings at hip height.
tendedero.imagen: Footprint of “Clothes airer”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Te”.

tabla_planchar.descripcion: Open ironing board: narrow, waist high, ending in a point. The legs cross underneath.
tabla_planchar.imagen: Footprint of “Ironing board”: a rectangle ending in a point on the right, 1.20 by 0.38 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

aspiradora.descripcion: Vacuum cleaner someone left in the way, hose trailing. Low: easy to trip over.
aspiradora.imagen: Footprint of “Vacuum cleaner on the floor”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.30 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “As”.

juguetes.descripcion: Toys scattered on the floor: bricks, a car, a ball. A low, uneven obstacle; they rattle when stepped on.
juguetes.imagen: Footprint of “Toys on the floor”: an irregular patch, 0.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ju”.

mesa_plegable.descripcion: Light folding table. Open here today; it may be gone another day.
mesa_plegable.imagen: Footprint of “Folding table”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

escalera_mano.descripcion: Stepladder open in the way. The legs spread at the bottom: wider on the floor than at the top.
escalera_mano.imagen: Footprint of “Open stepladder”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.50 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Em”.

puerta_terraza.descripcion: Sliding glass patio door. Closed, it is a full pane of glass blocking the way; open, you walk through.
puerta_terraza.imagen: Footprint of “Patio door”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.08 metres, marked with the letters “Pt”.

aparador.descripcion: Long, low cabinet at hip height against the dining room wall: doors below, drawers above and the crockery inside. There is usually a fruit bowl or photos on top that fall over if you lean on it.
aparador.imagen: Footprint of “Sideboard”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ap”.

chimenea.descripcion: Masonry or cast-iron fireplace against the wall, with a stone hearth sticking out in front at ankle height: you trip on it before you feel the heat. When lit it crackles and burns; the glass front, if it has one, is scorching.
chimenea.imagen: Footprint of “Wood-burning fireplace”: a wide body against the wall and a hearth slab sticking out at the front, 1.20 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

mesa_camilla_brasero.descripcion: Round table dressed in thick fabric skirts reaching the floor; underneath, an electric heater warms your legs. The cane meets soft cloth, not legs, and warmth comes out from below.
mesa_camilla_brasero.imagen: Footprint of “Skirted table with heater”: a circle, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

puf_reposapies.descripcion: Upholstered stool with no visible legs, firm, at shin height. It stays wherever it was left and is easy to trip over; some open up to store blankets.
puf_reposapies.imagen: Footprint of “Footstool pouffe”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

mecedora.descripcion: Armchair on two curved rockers sticking out at the front and back. Touch it and it rocks and creaks; the back rocker catches the feet of anyone walking behind.
mecedora.imagen: Footprint of “Rocking chair”: a seat between two curved rockers sticking out at the front and back, 0.60 by 0.95 metres, marked with the letters “Me”.

sofa_cama.descripcion: Sofa that unfolds into a bed: closed it takes the room of a sofa; open, the mattress comes out almost two metres forward on metal legs and blocks the way. Its size changes from day to day.
sofa_cama.imagen: Footprint of “Sofa bed”: a rectangle, 1.90 by 0.95 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

mesas_nido.descripcion: Two or three small tables tucked inside each other, beside the sofa. Stacked they are one low table; when there are guests they turn up loose around the living room.
mesas_nido.imagen: Footprint of “Nest of tables”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Mn”.

lampara_colgante.descripcion: Lamp hanging from the ceiling on a cord down to just over a metre and a half, over the dining table. With the table below it is harmless; if the table is moved, the shade is at face height and the cane misses it.
lampara_colgante.imagen: Footprint of “Low pendant lamp”: a circle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Lc”.

reloj_pie.descripcion: Tall, narrow wooden case, taller than a person, with a pendulum behind glass. Its tick-tock can be heard from the door and it strikes the hours: a good landmark.
reloj_pie.imagen: Footprint of “Grandfather clock”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Rp”.

rascador_gato.descripcion: Tower of posts wrapped in rough rope with carpeted platforms at different heights sticking out to the sides. It sways if you lean on it and sometimes there is a cat on top.
rascador_gato.imagen: Footprint of “Cat tree”: a base with platforms sticking out in several directions, 0.60 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Rg”.

ventilador_pie.descripcion: Heavy round base, a thin pole and at the top the guard with the blades, at chest height. When on it blows and hums and turns its head from side to side; the cane only finds the base.
ventilador_pie.imagen: Footprint of “Pedestal fan”: a circle, 0.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Vp”.

estufa_portatil.descripcion: Heater carried from room to room: the butane one, a cabinet on wheels with the gas bottle inside, or the oil-filled radiator, a row of metal fins. When on you feel the heat from a distance; the front and the top burn.
estufa_portatil.imagen: Footprint of “Portable heater”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.45 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Ep”.

aire_portatil.descripcion: Plastic box on wheels at waist height, with a fat corrugated hose running to the window across the floor. When on it roars and blows cold air from the top.
aire_portatil.imagen: Footprint of “Portable air conditioner”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.45 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ap”.

columna_despensa.descripcion: Tall kitchen unit, from the floor almost to the ceiling, with shelves or pull-out baskets for food. The door is tall and opens into the walkway; inside it smells of bread and spices.
columna_despensa.imagen: Footprint of “Larder unit”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cd”.

campana_extractora.descripcion: Metal hood hung above the hob, with its lower edge at forehead height. The cane gives no warning and leaning over the cooker you bump into it; when on it hums and sucks air upwards.

variantes.isla: Island hood, hung from the ceiling

campana_extractora.imagen: Footprint of “Cooker hood”: a narrow flue at the back and the wide hood at the front, 0.90 by 0.50 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ce”.

mesa_abatible_pared.descripcion: Board fixed to the wall on hinges with a bracket that holds it up. Down, it is a flat panel against the wall; up, it sticks out at waist height and the cane passes underneath without touching legs.
mesa_abatible_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Fold-down wall table”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

banco_rinconera.descripcion: L-shaped wooden bench filling the corner, with a backrest against both walls and a seat that lifts to store things. The table usually stands in front.
banco_rinconera.imagen: Footprint of “Kitchen corner bench”: an L shape, 1.60 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Br”.

cama_abatible.descripcion: A cupboard that is really a bed: by day it is a flat front against the wall; at night the bed swings down and takes up two metres of floor. Whatever is in front by day gets in the way at night.
cama_abatible.imagen: Footprint of “Fold-down wall bed”: a rectangle, 1.45 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

colchon_hinchable.descripcion: Thick plastic mattress blown up on the floor for a guest. Soft and slippery, it sinks when you step on it and squeaks like plastic when brushed. Here today; tomorrow, deflated in a cupboard.
colchon_hinchable.imagen: Footprint of “Inflatable mattress”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 1.40 by 1.95 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

columna_bano.descripcion: Tall, narrow cabinet beside the washbasin, with doors and shelves for towels and toiletries. It is deeper than the wall beside it and its corner juts into the way.
columna_bano.imagen: Footprint of “Bathroom tall cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.35 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

armario_espejo_bano.descripcion: Small cabinet hung above the washbasin with a mirrored door, at face height. It sticks out a hand's width and, when the door is open, the glass leaf ends up right in front of your head.
armario_espejo_bano.imagen: Footprint of “Mirrored bathroom cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ae”.

alfombrilla_bano.descripcion: Terry mat in front of the bath or shower. Soft and damp underfoot; without a rubber backing it slides on the tiles.
alfombrilla_bano.imagen: Footprint of “Bath mat”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.50 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ab”.

bascula_bano.descripcion: Flat glass or plastic platform on the floor, a hand's width high. You stub your toe on it; when you step on it, it beeps and announces or shows your weight.
bascula_bano.imagen: Footprint of “Bathroom scales”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.32 by 0.32 metres, marked with the letters “Bb”.

cesto_ropa.descripcion: Tall wicker or plastic basket with a lid, in a corner. Light: it tips over if you knock it and sounds hollow.
cesto_ropa.imagen: Footprint of “Laundry basket”: an oval, 0.40 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

portarrollos_pie.descripcion: Metal rod on a heavy base next to the toilet, with paper rolls threaded on and the brush in its holder. Thin and easy to knock over with your foot.
portarrollos_pie.imagen: Footprint of “Toilet roll stand with brush”: a circle, 0.22 by 0.22 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

escalera_caracol.descripcion: Staircase climbing in turns around a central pole, inside a circle of just over a metre and a half. The steps are triangles: wide at the outside, almost nothing by the pole. Climb on the outside holding the handrail.
escalera_caracol.imagen: Footprint of “Spiral staircase”: a circle, 1.60 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ec”.

escalera_buhardilla.descripcion: Hatch in the hallway ceiling from which a very steep folding ladder comes down. Folded away you do not notice it; down, it fills the hallway from side to side and the open hole is above.
escalera_buhardilla.imagen: Footprint of “Loft ladder”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Eb”.

tendedero_techo.descripcion: Rails hung from the ceiling on ropes and pulleys: lowered to hang the washing and raised to dry it. When lowered, the wet clothes are at face height; the cane does not find it.
tendedero_techo.imagen: Footprint of “Ceiling clothes airer”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.50 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Tt”.

congelador_arcon.descripcion: White metal box at hip height, with a full-width lid that lifts upwards. It hums constantly and, when opened, breathes out cold air.
congelador_arcon.imagen: Footprint of “Chest freezer”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

armario_escobero.descripcion: Tall, narrow single-door cupboard holding the broom, the mop, the bucket and the ironing board. When you open it something may fall out towards you.
armario_escobero.imagen: Footprint of “Broom cupboard”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ae”.

caldera_mural.descripcion: Appliance hung on the wall at head height, with pipes running down to the floor. When a hot tap is turned on it lights with a whoosh and roars quietly; the cane only finds the pipes.
caldera_mural.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-hung boiler or water heater”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.35 metres, hanging 1.40 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cm”.

maquina_coser.descripcion: Wooden cabinet at table height with the machine on top or hidden under a lid, and a pedal on the floor. Sewing, it clatters fast; there are usually pins and scraps around it.
maquina_coser.imagen: Footprint of “Sewing machine cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

sillon_colgante.descripcion: Round wicker or rope basket with cushions, hung from a metal arch on a heavy foot. It sways and turns when touched; the arch passes above your head.
sillon_colgante.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging egg chair”: the stand's foot at the back and the round basket hanging in front, 1.05 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

hamaca_soporte.descripcion: Fabric hammock hung between the two ends of a long wooden or metal stand. The stand's feet at either end trip you up; the fabric in the middle gives and sways.
hamaca_soporte.imagen: Footprint of “Hammock on a stand”: two wide feet at the ends joined by a narrow strip of fabric, 3.00 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Hs”.

barbacoa_portatil.descripcion: Round metal bowl on three legs at waist height, with a domed lid. When lit, the coals crackle, it smells of smoke and it burns on every side.
barbacoa_portatil.imagen: Footprint of “Kettle barbecue”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

lena_apilada.descripcion: Pile of cut logs against a wall, sometimes inside an iron log store. Rough and splintery; the top logs roll off if you touch them.

variantes.cesto: In a basket by the fire

lena_apilada.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked firewood”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “La”.

cortacesped.descripcion: Low wheeled deck with a long handle rising to waist height. Stopped on the lawn it is a low obstacle; running it roars and throws grass out, and you must keep your feet clear.
cortacesped.imagen: Footprint of “Lawn mower”: the handle at the back and the wide deck at the front, 0.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Co”.

armario_resina_terraza.descripcion: Hard plastic cabinet with grilled doors, against the terrace wall, storing tools, cushions and gas bottles. It sounds hollow when knocked.
armario_resina_terraza.imagen: Footprint of “Plastic outdoor storage cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

piscina_hinchable.descripcion: Plastic pool with an inflated rim at knee height, full of water. Around it the floor is wet and slippery; the rim gives if you lean on it.
piscina_hinchable.imagen: Footprint of “Paddling pool”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 2.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ph”.

cortina_tiras.descripcion: Curtain of plastic strips or beads hung in the frame of the terrace or kitchen door, to keep flies out. It does not block the way: you walk through and the strips rattle over your shoulders.
cortina_tiras.aviso: Strip curtain: you walk through it.
cortina_tiras.imagen: Footprint of “Strip door curtain”: a rectangle, 0.85 by 0.03 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

cama_nido.descripcion: Single bed, long side against the wall, with another bed hidden underneath that pulls out like a big drawer. Pulled out, the lower bed is at ankle height and fills the whole walkway beside the bed.
cama_nido.imagen: Footprint of “Trundle bed”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cn”.

cama_montessori.descripcion: Mattress almost at floor level inside a slatted frame shaped like a little house: four posts and a pitched roof above head height. The corner posts are found with the cane.
cama_montessori.imagen: Footprint of “Montessori house bed”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

cuna_colecho.descripcion: Small barred cot with one side open, pushed right up against the parents' bed at the same height as the mattress. There is no way through between the two beds.
cuna_colecho.imagen: Footprint of “Bedside co-sleeping cot”: a U of bars open on the side pushed against the big bed, 0.60 by 0.95 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

banera_bebe_patas.descripcion: Small plastic bath on a folding leg frame at waist height, sometimes with a changing top over it. Full, it is heavy and splashes; empty, it moves easily.
banera_bebe_patas.imagen: Footprint of “Baby bath on a stand”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.55 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Bb”.

gimnasio_bebe.descripcion: Padded mat on the floor with two crossed arches over it at knee height, hung with toys that jingle. Soft underfoot; the arches catch your feet.
gimnasio_bebe.imagen: Footprint of “Baby play gym”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.85 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Gb”.

taburete_escalon.descripcion: One- or two-step plastic stool in front of the washbasin or toilet, so a child can reach. Low and light: it trips you and slides.
taburete_escalon.imagen: Footprint of “Child's step stool”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 0.40 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Te”.

robot_aspirador.descripcion: Low disc that roams the floor on its own, humming, bumps into furniture, turns and carries on. It slips under beds and turns up between your feet: a moving obstacle.
robot_aspirador.imagen: Footprint of “Robot vacuum running”: a circle, 0.35 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Ra”.
